title: School of Music Student Advisory Committee Chair
description: As Chair of the School of Music Student Advisory Committee at the University of Utah, I lead student governance and advocacy efforts within the School of Music. I facilitate communication between students, faculty, and administration, coordinate committee meetings, and work to enhance the educational experience and community engagement for music students.

title: Music Entrepreneurship Officer
description: As Music Entrepreneurship Officer at the University of Utah, I support initiatives that help music students develop business skills and entrepreneurial mindsets. I organize workshops, networking events, and resources to prepare students for diverse career paths in the music industry.

title: Fine Arts Fees Grants Representative
description: As Fine Arts Fees Grants Representative at the University of Utah, I oversee the allocation and management of student fee funding for fine arts initiatives. I review grant applications, advocate for equitable distribution of resources, and ensure that student fees support meaningful programs and opportunities within the College of Fine Arts.

title: College of Fine Arts Council: School of Music Student Representative
description: As the School of Music Student Representative on the College of Fine Arts Council at the University of Utah, I represent the interests and perspectives of music students in college-wide decision-making processes. I participate in council meetings, contribute to policy discussions, and ensure that music student voices are heard in matters affecting the broader fine arts community.

title: University of Utah Chapter Officer
description: As a Chapter Officer for the Music Teachers National Association at the University of Utah, I help coordinate professional development opportunities and networking events for music education students. I work to connect students with the broader music teaching community and promote excellence in music education.

title: The Leukemia & Lymphoma Society
description: As a fundraiser for The Leukemia & Lymphoma Society, I organized and executed fundraising initiatives to support cancer research and patient services. Through benefit concerts and community outreach, I raised awareness and financial support for blood cancer treatment and research programs.

title: Hope Clinic Volunteer Staff
description: As volunteer staff at Hope Clinic, I supported healthcare delivery to underserved populations. I assisted with patient intake, administrative tasks, and clinic operations, contributing to the mission of providing accessible healthcare services to those in need.

title: School of Music Student Advisory Committee Secretary
description: As Secretary of the School of Music Student Advisory Committee at the University of Utah, I documented committee proceedings, maintained records, and facilitated communication among committee members. I supported the committee's mission to advocate for student interests and improve the music program.
